title: Texts — Editing the introduction and highlights
body:
On the **Texts** tab you can rewrite the texts that appear on your page. You don't need to "program" anything:
whatever you type here and save is what shows up on your website.

![Screenshot: the Texts tab on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## The four fields

1. **„Business name”** — the name of your accommodation, as it will appear at the top of the page and in Google search results.
2. **„Tagline (short line in the header)”** — a single sentence that appears below the name.
   A good slogan captures the essence: for example, the location or the atmosphere.
3. **„Introductory text”** — a few paragraphs about what makes staying with you great. Write as you would
   tell a guest: what's nearby, and what they can only get at your place.
4. **„Highlights (one per line)”** — short, list-like strengths (e.g. "Private parking").
   Each line appears as a separate little label on the page — write only ONE thing per line.

## Saving

When you tap the **„Save and refresh”** button, the change takes effect immediately: after the green **„Mentve — az oldalad frissült.”** confirmation, opening your page will already show the new texts. You can't do any harm —
you can always type back whatever was there before.
